dict.string: When you say "this", Jarvis reads the address of the tab you have open in Chrome or Safari so Aside knows what you mean.
Jarvis listens to what your Mac itself is playing (videos, music, calls) only to ignore it, so a video saying "Hey Jarvis" never wakes him. It stays on your Mac and is kept for 15 seconds.
Hey Aside listens on-device for "Hey Aside" and your request, then hands the text to Aside. Audio never leaves your Mac.
Hey Aside transcribes your request on-device with Apple's speech recognizer.
